findings.criterion: bounded service lifecycle across multiple requests
findings.location: runtime/p2_rpc.py:serve while True; executor RuntimeMaxSec360 and publisher RuntimeMaxSec180
findings.evidence: Idle timeout resets on each accept; daemon admits unlimited sequential requests. Service lifetime clocks span all requests, without remaining-budget check or rotation.
findings.impact: A valid later request can start just before service lifetime expiry and be killed; verification stays pending/effect_unknown despite its own request budget.
findings.remediation: Rotate service per request or bound admission against remaining service lifetime, preserving host timeout protections; targeted consecutive-request evidence.
